# saphira-llm I2_S golden vectors
# Captured from the REFERENCE, never from us.
#
#   tensor records  : dequantize_row_i2_s over every element of a real
#                     tensor. Verified by FNV-1a 64 over all of it, so the
#                     gate covers millions of values without storing them.
#   gemv records    : ggml_gemv_i2_i8_s and ggml_gemm_i2_i8_s on real weights
#                     against a fixed synthetic activation, plus the act
#                     scale and sum our quantiser must produce to match.
#
# The activation quantiser is the only free variable here: the reference
# takes an already-quantised int8 row, so the fixture pins the exact input
# our quantiser has to reproduce before the kernels mean anything.
